text: Severity narrowed by a step-1 probe against the Java2D oracle. The existing sweep paths, closed, with named Dashed and Dotted show zero disagreements at step-1 sampling even where the seam-join branch does fire (Dashed on p3/p5, Dotted on p2/p5) --- ordinary polygons with the named rhythms are not affected, and the sweep's step-2 grid is not masking a broader problem. The only reproductions found are the axis-aligned rectangle of perimeter 56 (2 disagreeing points at step 1, 0 on the sweep's own step-2 grid) and the degenerate two-point closed path with a four-segment custom rhythm, where the seam is a 180-degree reversal. Both require the last dash to end exactly on the seam.
